topic.title: Nested if and Multi-Way if-else Statements
topic.description: Complex decision making with nested conditions

sections.title: 🎯 What You'll Learn
sections.content:
Ready to level up your decision-making in code? Nested if and multi-way if-else statements let you handle complex choices like a pro!

• How to stack conditions inside conditions (nested if)
• How to create clear decision trees with multi-way if-else
• When to use each approach for cleaner code

sections.title: 💡 Concept Explanation
sections.content:
Imagine you're at a coffee shop with a loyalty program:
- First, you check if you're a member (if statement)
- Then, you check what tier you're in (nested if)
- Finally, you get your discount based on all those conditions

That's exactly how nested if statements work! They let you ask follow-up questions after the first decision.

**Nested if statements** are like Russian nesting dolls - conditions inside conditions:
• First check: Are you a member?
• If yes, check: Gold, Silver, or Bronze tier?
• Then apply the right discount

**Multi-way if-else** is like a game show with multiple doors:
• Door 1: Score > 90 → A grade
• Door 2: Score > 80 → B grade
• Door 3: Score > 70 → C grade
• Default: Try again next time!

steps.title: Final Action

sections.title: ⚡ Key Points
points: ✓ Nested if = conditions inside conditions (like a decision tree)
✓ Multi-way if-else = multiple mutually exclusive options
✓ Always indent properly to show nesting levels
✓ Use multi-way when checking the same variable multiple times

sections.title: 🔥 Tips & Mistakes
dos: Use clear variable names for conditions
Keep nesting to 2-3 levels max (or refactor)
donts: Don't nest too deep (hard to read!)
Don't forget the 'else' for default cases
Don't put unrelated conditions in the same if-else chain
sections.protip: For multi-way if-else, order your conditions from most specific to least specific (like checking for 'Gold' before 'Silver')

sections.title: 🌍 Real World Use
sections.content: Where is Nested if and Multi-Way if-else Statements used in real apps?

examples.how: Nested ifs check: 1) Is user logged in? 2) Is item in stock? 3) What's their shipping method? 4) Do they have coupons?
Multi-way if-else determines: 1) What level is player? 2) What power-ups do they have? 3) What enemies to spawn?
Nested conditions verify: 1) Is account active? 2) Is balance sufficient? 3) Is transaction within daily limit?

problem.description:
Write a program that determines a student's letter grade based on their score and attendance. Rules:
• A: 90+ AND attendance ≥ 90%
• B: 80-89 OR (70-79 AND attendance ≥ 80%)
• C: 70-79 AND attendance < 80%
• F: Below 70 OR attendance < 70%
hints: Start with the highest grade condition first
Use nested if for the B grade condition
Remember to handle the default case (F grade)
problem.explanation: We check conditions from most specific to least specific. The B grade uses a nested condition to check both score ranges and attendance. The order matters - if we checked for B first, some A students might get misclassified!

sections.title: 📝 Summary
points: 📌 Nested if lets you ask follow-up questions after a condition is met
📌 Multi-way if-else handles multiple exclusive options cleanly
📌 Always test all possible paths through your conditions
📌 You're now ready to handle complex decision-making in your programs!
